select r.record_id, r.borrow_no, r.book_id, r.reader_id, r.borrow_date, r.due_date, r.return_date, r.last_reminder_time, r.renew_count, r.reminder_count, r.status, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, b.book_name, b.isbn, b.cover, b.author, lr.reader_no, u.nick_name, u.user_name, as overdue_days, round(() * 0.50, 2) as fine_amount from lib_borrow_record r left join lib_book b on r.book_id = b.book_id left join lib_reader lr on r.reader_id = lr.reader_id left join sys_user u on lr.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' order by r.record_id desc
mapper.update: update lib_borrow_record set status = '1', return_date = #{returnDate}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId} and status in ('0', '2')

update lib_borrow_record set due_date = #{dueDate}, renew_count = #{renewCount}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId} and status in ('0', '2')

update lib_borrow_record set reminder_count = ifnull(reminder_count, 0) + 1, last_reminder_time = #{lastReminderTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId} and status = '2'
mapper.select: select count(1) from lib_borrow_record where reader_id = #{readerId} and status in ('0', '2')
select count(1) from lib_borrow_record where reader_id = #{readerId} and book_id = #{bookId} and status in ('0', '2')
mapper.update: update lib_borrow_record set status = '2', update_time = sysdate() where status = '0' and due_date < sysdate()
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when r.status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as borrowingCount, sum(case when r.status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as returnedCount, sum(case when r.status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as overdueCount, sum(round((case when ifnull(r.return_date, sysdate()) > r.due_date then timestampdiff(day, r.due_date, ifnull(r.return_date, sysdate())) else 0 end) * 0.50, 2)) as pendingFineAmount from lib_borrow_record r left join lib_reader lr on r.reader_id = lr.reader_id left join sys_user u on lr.user_id = u.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0'
